title: design/ship.json
description: What this version of the game is: when it ships, where, its core loop in a sentence, and what it leaves out. Read by every agent before it works on the game.

shipDate.description: The day the game goes out, YYYY-MM-DD.

platforms.description: Where it goes out, such as "itch.io" or "OhMyGame Community".

core.description: The game in one sentence: what the player does, again and again.

deadline.description: Date and time with its offset, such as 2026-12-07T23:00:00+08:00.

coreProbe.description: A check that the core loop does something: game_use actions, and a path in the game's playtest snapshot they should change.
